aboutUs: SkillAd is an India-wide skill marketplace connecting skilled workers with customers nearby.
termsOfService:
By using SkillAd, you agree that SkillAd acts only as an advertisement and communication platform connecting users with independent service providers. SkillAd does not employ, manage, guarantee, or directly provide any services listed on the platform. Users and service providers are solely responsible for their communications, agreements, payments, and service quality.

Service providers are responsible for maintaining accurate profile information and professional behavior. Users may provide ratings and reviews based on their service experience. SkillAd reserves the right to suspend, remove, or permanently block any account involved in fraud, abusive behavior, fake information, illegal activity, harassment, or inappropriate content.

Uploading sexually explicit, abusive, misleading, or illegal images or content is strictly prohibited. If complaints are received regarding inappropriate profile photos or activities, the admin has full authority to remove content and block the account without prior notice.

SkillAd does not guarantee the quality, safety, legality, or authenticity of any service provider or user. Users are encouraged to independently verify service providers before hiring.
privacyPolicy:
SkillAd respects the privacy of its users and service providers. We collect basic information such as mobile number, name, profile details, location, service category, and profile photos to help users connect with nearby service providers more efficiently.

Location access is used only to show nearby services and improve search accuracy. Mobile numbers may be used for authentication, communication, notifications, and account security purposes.

SkillAd does not sell personal user information to unauthorized third parties. However, users understand that basic profile information such as name, service category, ratings, and contact options may be visible publicly within the app to help users connect with service providers.

Users are responsible for the information they upload on the platform. Any inappropriate, sexually explicit, fake, abusive, or unlawful content may result in account suspension or permanent removal.

While SkillAd attempts to maintain a safe and reliable platform through mobile verification and moderation, we cannot guarantee the behavior or authenticity of users and service providers. Users should exercise their own judgment and caution while hiring or providing services through the platform.

faqs.question: What is SkillAd?
faqs.answer: SkillAd is an India-wide skill marketplace that helps you find verified local professionals — electricians, plumbers, tutors, beauticians, drivers and many more — based on your location.

faqs.question: Is SkillAd free for customers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Customers can search providers, chat, and book services through the SkillAd app at no charge. Providers use subscription plans to stay visible and receive booking requests.

faqs.question: How does location-based discovery work?
faqs.answer: SkillAd shows providers whose service area covers your current location. You only see professionals who actually serve where you are — not a random city-wide list.

faqs.question: How do I book a service?
faqs.answer: Open the SkillAd app, search or browse a category, open a provider profile, then start a chat and send a booking request. The provider can accept, and you can confirm when the work is done.

faqs.question: Which languages does SkillAd support?
faqs.answer: SkillAd supports multiple Indian languages in the mobile app so you can use the platform in the language you prefer.

faqs.question: How do I become a provider?
faqs.answer: Download the SkillAd app, create an account, register as a provider with your skills and service area, then activate a subscription plan to appear in customer search results.
